primary_title: TNFalpha and IL-1beta modify the miRNA cargo of astrocyte shed extracellular vesicles to regulate neurotrophic signaling in neurons
decision_basis: The review-traced primary shows that IL-1beta and TNFalpha stimulation increases astrocyte EV release and enriches the EV cargo with miR-125a-5p and miR-16-5p, which are then detected in the neuronal-response experiments.

primary_title: TNFalpha and IL-1beta modify the miRNA cargo of astrocyte shed extracellular vesicles to regulate neurotrophic signaling in neurons
decision_basis: The review-traced primary shows that inflammatory astrocyte EVs carrying miR-125a-5p and miR-16-5p reduce neuronal dendritic complexity, neurite measures, spontaneous spike rates and burst activity, while molecular inhibition of the cargo miRNAs rescues these effects.
limitations_preserved: Keep dendritic morphology and electrophysiology as measured neuronal outputs; do not infer a direct receptor, TF, or SCI-specific mechanism.
